metaTitle: Custom Gray Pocket Utility Knives | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gray pocket utility knives with your logo. Ideal for safety managers and bulk giveaways at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray pocket utility knives offer a sleek, professional look that stands out from standard silver or black options. The neutral gray tone pairs well with corporate logos and safety branding, making these knives a popular choice for construction crews, warehouse teams, and trade show giveaways. Choose from retractable or folding styles, and add your imprint via pad printing or laser engraving for a durable, lasting mark.
